extraction.notes: Attachment 2 (seq 10, printed page 3), three months ended June 30, 2025 column. The FFO subtotal is presented twice: basic FFO of 215,381 and diluted FFO of 216,592. I used the diluted subtotal as ffo_total, with the Series E preferred distribution (1,211) carried in ffo_adjustments so the chain reconciles and the FFO as Adjusted diluted figure follows. Basic FFO (215,381) is the printed subtotal before that distribution. The 'Net (gain)/loss on the sale of depreciable real estate' line is '-' for 2Q 2025, so it is omitted. 'Net (gain)/loss on consolidation' (286) is categorized as 'other' because it does not fit a listed category. Software transition costs are mapped to severance_restructuring per the category list. The starting line is net income attributable to common stockholders (36,462); the NOI reconciliation's UDR, Inc. net income (37,673) is a different line and was not used. AFFO already deducts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted shares of 357,370 (thousands) reproduce the per-share figures: 216,592/357,370 = 0.61, 227,543/357,370 = 0.64, and 198,342/357,370 = 0.56.
